items.summary_en: Scientists have rediscovered two plant species in the highlands of Minas Gerais, Brazil, that were believed to be extinct for 30 years. Among the findings were Paepalanthus magalhaesii and Coracoralina amoena, known as everlasting flowers. The discovery highlights the importance of preserving the region's unique biodiversity.

items.title_en: Researchers Find Plants Thought Extinct for 30 Years
